ops.body: I read the final reposync lenses (13 and 12 findings, overlaps). Please triage with reproduced scenarios, not blanket severity, and parallelize independent fix groups in isolated worktrees where practical (capture/LFS/index state, history-cache validity, receiver verify/restore/collision/network policy), with explicit ownership of shared schema/source files. Avoid a single long fix stage serializing unrelated ready work as happened in the initial Orca pass. Keep unsupported source state visibly incomplete rather than false Ready; do not silently drop data to satisfy tests. No new full-review cycle is needed after reproduced fixes beyond targeted refutation plus the already-required final acceptance, unless changes create a new unresolved concern.
